messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: canary deployment 'image-service-v3' is failing health checks in eu-west-1-canary - 12/12 pods restarting in 6m with OOMKilled. Alert severity: P1.

 dave_oncall: I'm on it. pulling up the canary dashboard and logs. Anybody still running the rollout?

 alice_sre: I see spikes in RSS memory for the new sidecar (metrics-agent) right before OOM. PID 1 (app) shows steady memory but sidecar grows unbounded.

 bob_platform: The rollout was a standard canary via the deployer job at 2003002400, 10% traffic. No manual interventions reported. I'll pause any further deploys.

 carol_eng: Confirmed the new sidecar image 'metrics-agent:2.0.0' was introduced in this rollout. I pushed that change. Reproducing locally now.

 incident-bot: @dave_oncall Escalation: page oncall-manager and product-sre.

 support-bot: Customer impact: a handful of requests in eu-west-1 are receiving 503s when the canary frontends try to route to backends. No broad customer outage yet.

 alice_sre: k8s event tail from one failing pod: ```
State: CrashLoopBackOff
Last Termination: OOMKilled
Logs: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
--- sidecar container logs ---
Heap usage trend: 300MB -> 1.6GB -> OOM
```

 dave_oncall: Node drain was running earlier for an unrelated kernel patch, could be compounding. Any PodDisruptionBudget preventing eviction?

 bob_platform: PDB exists for image-service: maxUnavailable=1. The drain may have caused one replica to be rescheduled, but the memory growth is per-pod so it would still hit OOM on reschedule.

 carol_eng: Quick mitigation: flip the feature flag to disable metrics-agent sidecar for the canary. Can someone run the kill-switch? I can cut a hotfix otherwise.

 dave_oncall: @bob_platform can you run the flag rollback? I don't have permissions for prod flags.

 bob_platform: Running flag toggle now... :spinner: 10% -> 0% for canary group.

 deploy-bot: Rollout action: feature-flag set image-service.metrics_agent_enabled=false for rollout group=canary by bob_platform at 2003002542.

 carol_eng: Watching pods... pods starting to stabilize. New pods without sidecar are staying up. Memory usage for app container is normalizing (~220MB).

 incident-bot: Update: alert count decreasing. Canary health checks passing for 7m. Auto-escalation suspended.

 dave_oncall: Good. Now to address root cause: carol, do you have a reproducer? We should also roll back the canary image to v2.9 while we investigate.

 carol_eng: I can reproduce the leak in a load testing harness when the metrics-agent is enabled and a specific endpoint (/batch/ingest) is exercised. Looks like a memory retention in the agent's buffer. I'll open a GH issue and pin a revert PR.

 bob_platform: Queued a canary revert: deployer scheduled rollback to image-service:v2.9 at 2003002650. No impact on stable cluster.

 deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: canary set image=image-service:v2.9 by bob_platform. Estimated completion 2m.

 support-bot: Customer impact summary for pager: ~12 requests failed over a 9-minute window in eu-west-1. No escalations from enterprise customers. Notifying CS to monitor.

 alice_sre: Post-mortem notes to capture: interaction between node drain timing and untested sidecar memory usage; feature-flag path allowed rapid mitigation; HPA did not help because crashloop prevented scale-up. Also add runbook step: consider circuit-breaker for new sidecars.

 dave_oncall: Handing off to alice_sre and carol_eng for remediation and write-up. I'll mark incident as recovered. If anyone sees regressions, re-pager me. :thumbsup:

 incident-bot: Incident update: RECOVERED at 2003002705. Incident lead: dave_oncall. Links: deployer://2003002650, github://repo/issue/3456.

 carol_eng: Filing GH issue now with stack traces and reproduction steps. Will schedule a canary redeploy after agent fix and memory limits enforced.

 alice_sre: I'll start the postmortem doc and include action items: add E2E load test for sidecars, set memory requests/limits for metrics-agent, add faster kill-switch runbook, and make canary traffic isolation stricter.

 dave_oncall: Thanks team. Logging this thread to incidents and tagging for 1hr 1:1 post-incident review.

 support-bot: Notifying customers in eu-west-1 - status updated to "degraded" for 10 minutes then to "operational" after recovery.

 incident-bot: Thread closed by dave_oncall at 2003002720.
